task: Draft a 60–90-word engineering reading note and one IEEE reference for the fictional datasheet. Distinguish a nominal interval from the stated upper interval limit and keep the temperature condition attached. This is document-based explanation, not a test report. Use [1] before sentence punctuation. Venue reference form: [1] Corporate author, “Title,” Datasheet number, revision, month year. [Online]. Available: URL. The source is a datasheet, not a standard, experiment, or conference paper. Do not calculate unrequested performance metrics or retrieve the URL.

facts.text: Datasheet record: Astercoil Devices; R3 timebase; Datasheet DS-17; revision B; February 2025; https://example.org/r3/ds17-b.
The datasheet gives a nominal tick interval of 2 ms and an upper interval limit of 5 ms for operation from 0 to 35 °C.
The supplied datasheet does not specify interval behavior outside 0 to 35 °C.
No device was run or measured for this writing exercise.
